title: Undelivered Parcels under Delivery Claims: Delivery-Charge Refund Calculation Sheet
content:
Refund Operations calculation sheet for the undelivered-parcel delivery refund on an approved Delivery Claims Delivered Not Received or Lost in Transit Claim.

**Calculation.** The undelivered-parcel delivery refund is the order's effective shipping fee and surcharge paid. The refund is rounded to the nearest cent once, on the final figure.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| effective shipping fee | the shipping fee shown on the order — the fee charged after any waiver |
| surcharge | the surcharge shown on the order |

## Assembly

- The refunded parcel charge is figured on the effective shipping fee plus the surcharge; every proportion of it that is paid is taken of that figure itself, proportions being multiplied together and never acting on one another's results.
- Tax on the refunded parcel charge, where the order bears any, is added to it.
- The single rounding to the nearest cent falls on the amount booked; nothing is rounded before it.

## Worked figure (hypothetical order)

An order showing an effective shipping fee of 7.95 USD and a surcharge of 1.50 USD: the undelivered-parcel delivery refund is 7.95 plus 1.50, that is 9.45 USD.
